claims.claim: Q2 2026 bookings reached $307M annualized GAAP base rent at 100% share, backlog reached a record $1.9B, and July added two hyperscale leases representing $410M annualized base rent at 100% share; this is a strong forward demand signal for digital-infrastructure capacity.

risks.risk: Signed backlog has a weighted-average commencement lag and therefore does not equal current-period realized revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental power-delivery constraints and customer concentration by new hyperscale lease are not resolved by this release.

claims.claim: Digital Realty raised 2026 Core FFO/share excluding net promote outlook to $8.15-$8.20 after Q2, while Q2 revenue rose 29% year over year and renewal cash rents increased 25.4%, indicating execution ahead of the prior outlook trajectory.

risks.risk: Q2 included promote income and an insurance settlement, so headline FFO requires normalization; issuer separately reports Core FFO excluding net promote.
